package handlers

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestDiagnosticHandlerRejectsMalformedAndMissingKeyWithoutDetails(t *testing.T) {
	h := DiagnosticAssessmentPlanHandler{}
	for _, body := range []string{"{}", strings.Repeat("x", (64<<10)+1)} {
		r := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/diagnostic-assessment-plans", strings.NewReader(body))
		r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w := httptest.NewRecorder()
		h.IssuePlan(w, r)
		if w.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || strings.Contains(w.Body.String(), "upstream") {
			t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", w.Code, w.Body.String())
		}
	}
}
